title: Beckhoff
summary: Beckhoff builds PC-based control: Embedded PCs (CX) or industrial PCs run TwinCAT 3, and EtherCAT Terminals provide the I/O.

sections.heading: Platforms
sections.body:
| Component | Role |
| --- | --- |
| CX Embedded PC | DIN-rail PC running TwinCAT |
| TwinCAT 3 | Engineering and runtime (IEC 61131-3, integrated in Visual Studio) |
| EtherCAT Terminals (EL) | I/O terminals on the EtherCAT fieldbus |

sections.heading: Conventions worth knowing
sections.body:
- Variables are declared with `AT %I*` / `AT %Q*` and **linked** to terminal channels in the I/O tree.
- Analog terminals for 4..20 mA represent 4 mA as 0 and 20 mA as 32767 in the default presentation.
- EtherCAT diagnostics (WcState, terminal state machine) are part of every fault investigation.
